name: Color Format Converter
tagline: Convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL and HSV
description: Convert any color between HEX (#RRGGBB), RGB (r, g, b), HSL (hue, saturation, lightness), and HSV (hue, saturation, value) formats. Useful for design, CSS, and frontend development.

expert_defs.name: color_converter_convert
expert_defs.description: Converts a color from HEX, RGB or HSL to all other formats. Params: color (color string), input_format (hex/rgb/hsl). Returns JSON with output_type json showing hex, rgb, hsl and hsv values.

conceptTexts: Plugin: Color Format Converter (id: color-converter). Expert color_converter_convert converts colors between HEX, RGB, HSL and HSV. Params: color (color value string), input_format (hex/rgb/hsl). Returns {output_type: 'json', data: {hex, rgb, hsl, hsv, components}}.
